aboutSubheading: Local craftsmanship with a national reputation
aboutText: Nexus Stone has been serving Coolaroo and surrounding areas with high-quality stone products and services for over a decade. Specialising in custom countertops, vanities, and tiling solutions, we bring craftsmanship and attention to detail to every project. Our team is dedicated to transforming spaces with durable and stylish stone installations, trusted by homeowners and businesses alike.
servicesText: From custom countertops to complete tiling projects, Nexus Stone provides a full range of stone services. We handle everything from design consultation to final installation, ensuring each piece is perfectly suited to your needs.

services.title: Custom Countertops
services.desc: We design and install bespoke stone countertops tailored to your kitchen or bathroom, using premium materials for lasting beauty and functionality.

services.title: Vanities & Shower Bases
services.desc: Craft elegant vanities and durable shower bases from natural or engineered stone, custom-fitted to your specifications.

services.title: Tiles and Wall Panels
services.desc: Expert installation of stone tiles and wall panels to enhance walls, floors, and backsplashes with a touch of luxury.

services.title: Commercial Stone Projects
services.desc: Complete stone solutions for businesses, from office fit-outs to retail spaces, delivered on time and within budget.

services.title: Stone Consultation & Design
services.desc: Free consultations to help you choose the right stone products for your project, with expert advice on design and maintenance.

services.title: Installation & Repair Services
services.desc: Professional installation and repair services to ensure your stone surfaces remain in perfect condition for years to come.

bannerSubheading: We're here to help with all your stone needs.

reviews.text: We had Nexus Stone install custom granite countertops in our Coolaroo home, and the result was stunning. Their attention to detail and professional service made the entire process seamless.

reviews.text: As a local business owner, I needed reliable stone suppliers for our restaurant renovation. Nexus Stone delivered high-quality wall panels and countertops on schedule. Highly recommend their commercial services.
reviews.name: James O'Connell

reviews.text: Nexus Stone provided excellent tiling services for our apartment complex in Coolaroo. Their team was efficient, and the finish was impeccable. We've used them for multiple properties now.
